caption: A cyclist riding along a flat street stops pedalling and rests both feet on the pedals, and the bicycle coasts on down the street, gradually slowing.
expectation: The bicycle keeps rolling forward after the legs stop, with no pause or jolt at the moment pedalling ends; the path stays straight and the wheels keep turning; it slows only gently, never speeding up, stopping dead, or rolling backward while the feet stay still.

caption: A girl spinning on an office chair grabs the edge of the desk to stop, and her ponytail swings on around her head after the chair has stopped.
expectation: The hair continues in the direction of the spin for a moment after the chair halts and then falls; it does not stop with the chair or swing the other way first.

caption: A stack of newspapers rides a conveyor belt in a printing plant, and when the belt is stopped the stack slides on a little before halting.
expectation: The slide is in the belt's former direction and starts as the belt stops; the stack stops within a short distance and does not slide backward.

caption: The cord holding a hanging flowerpot on a porch snaps, and the pot falls and breaks on the boards below.
expectation: The pot drops straight down the moment the cord parts, speeding up, and breaks on impact with soil spilling; it does not hover or fall sideways.

caption: A sandbag hanging from a hook in a gym is unhooked and drops onto the mat below.
expectation: The bag starts falling the instant it leaves the hook, drops straight down with increasing speed, lands on the mat and slumps; the empty hook swings; the bag does not drift sideways or pause.

caption: A phone balanced on a balcony rail slips off and falls into the swimming pool below with a splash.
expectation: The phone falls straight down, faster as it goes, and enters the water with a splash then sinks; it does not drift outward or float.

caption: A pigeon flies straight at a closed window, hits the glass with a thump, bounces off and drops to the ground below.
expectation: The pigeon stops at the pane and is thrown back at the instant of impact; the glass stays whole and nothing passes through it; the bird falls after the bounce and does not fly on through the window.

caption: A football kicked at goal hits the crossbar and drops down onto the goal line.
expectation: The ball rebounds off the bar at the moment of contact and falls under gravity; the bar does not bend and the ball does not pass through it.

caption: A cue ball is struck into a tight triangle of balls on a pool table, and the balls scatter across the table in all directions.
expectation: The balls move only after being struck, spread outward from the impact, and none overlaps another; the cue ball slows sharply.

caption: A marble rolls across a table and hits a heavy steel ball at rest; the marble bounces back the way it came while the steel ball barely moves.
expectation: At contact the marble reverses and rolls back slower than it arrived; the steel ball shifts at most slightly; neither passes through the other and the steel ball does not shoot off.

caption: A bottle cap spun on a kitchen counter spins in place, slows, and rattles to a stop.
expectation: The spin slows steadily and the cap wobbles more as it slows; it does not speed up or stop instantly.

caption: A wet bar of soap is squeezed in a hand in the bath, slips out of the grip and skids across the bottom of the tub.
expectation: The soap leaves the hand as the fingers close and shoots out in one direction; it skids across the wet surface in a straight line and slows to a stop or stops against the side of the tub; it does not hover, change direction on its own, or stay stuck to the hand.

caption: A tin can lying on its side and a wooden block are given the same shove across a floor; the can rolls far while the block stops within a short distance.
expectation: Both start moving together; the block slows quickly and stops while the can rolls on much farther before stopping; neither speeds up or changes direction on its own.

caption: A water balloon is lobbed over a garden fence and arcs over into a paddling pool on the other side.
expectation: The balloon rises, clears the fence near the top of its arc, wobbles in flight, and falls into the pool with a splash; it does not travel flat or hang above the fence.

caption: A weighted fishing line is cast far out over a lake from the bank, and the weight splashes into the water.
expectation: The weight flies in an arc, pulling line behind it, and drops into the water; it does not stop in the air or fly straight.

caption: A tennis ball rolls off the end of a table and curves down to the floor, landing a short distance out from the table's edge, and bounces on.
expectation: The ball keeps moving forward as it leaves the edge and drops in a curve that steepens; it lands beyond the edge, not straight below it, and does not stop in the air or fall straight down.

caption: A house of playing cards stands on a table; the table is bumped and the house collapses into a heap.
expectation: The collapse begins at the bump and runs through the structure in under a second; every card ends flat or leaning on the table; none stays balanced in the air.

caption: A ladder leaning at too shallow an angle against a garden wall slides out at its feet and falls flat to the ground.
expectation: The feet slip away from the wall first, the top slides down the wall as the angle flattens, and the ladder lands flat; it does not stay propped once the feet move or fall toward the wall.

caption: A bin standing in a yard is knocked by the swinging end of a long ladder and tips over.
expectation: The bin tips at the moment the ladder end hits it and falls in the direction of the swing, spilling; it does not move before contact.

caption: The cord of a window blind is pulled, and the blind gathers upward as the cord runs down.
expectation: The blind rises only as fast as the cord is pulled and stops when the pulling stops; the cord stays taut on the pulled side and does not stretch.

caption: A marionette is lifted off the stage by its control bar, and the strings go taut and the puppet's limbs hang from them.
expectation: The strings straighten as the bar lifts, the limbs rise only when their strings tighten, and the strings go slack when the puppet is set down.

caption: The anchor rope of a small boat is hauled in, and the rope comes up taut and dripping until the anchor breaks the surface.
expectation: The rope runs straight down into the water under load and stays taut while pulled; water drips from it; the anchor appears only when enough rope is in.

caption: A vacuum-packed foam mattress is cut open, and the flat compressed slab swells and puffs up toward its full thickness.
expectation: The foam expands as soon as the bag is opened, thickening evenly and slowing as it nears full size; it does not stay flat, shrink, or grow beyond a mattress shape.

caption: A rubber duck is squeezed under the bathwater and released, and it squirts water and puffs back to shape.
expectation: The duck flattens while squeezed, a jet of water comes out of its hole, and it refills and rounds out when released.

caption: A sheet of aluminium foil is pressed down over an upturned bowl and lifted off, and the foil keeps the bowl's rounded shape.
expectation: The foil wrinkles and moulds to the bowl while pressed and holds that dome shape after it is lifted away; it does not spring back flat or tear.

caption: A cable tie holding a bundle of cables is snipped with cutters, and the bundle springs apart into loose cables.
expectation: The tie parts where the blades close and the cables spread out at that instant; the tie does not rejoin and the bundle does not stay tight without it.

caption: A plank on a sawhorse is sawn through, and the cut end drops to the ground as the saw comes through.
expectation: The kerf deepens with each stroke, sawdust falls, and the piece parts only when the saw is through; the two pieces do not rejoin.

caption: A sheet of paper is fed into a shredder, and it comes out the bottom as a bundle of thin strips.
expectation: The sheet is drawn in at the top and strips emerge below as it passes; the sheet does not reappear whole.

caption: Thick paint is poured from a tin onto a flat canvas, and it spreads slowly into a rounded pool and stops.
expectation: The paint flows outward from where it lands, slower and thicker than water would, and settles into a rounded shape with a raised edge; it does not keep spreading thin or climb back into the tin.

caption: A large stone is dropped into a bucket full of water, and water spills over the rim onto the ground.
expectation: The splash and overflow happen as the stone enters, the level stays at the rim afterward, and the stone sinks to the bottom; the stone does not pass through the bucket.

caption: The plug of a full bathtub is pulled, and as the water drains a swirling whirlpool forms over the drain.
expectation: The level falls steadily and a dimple over the drain deepens into a spinning funnel that grows as the water gets shallower; the water does not rise or spin without draining.

caption: A bucket with a hole near its bottom is filled from a tap, and a thin stream squirts out of the hole and arcs onto the ground.
expectation: The stream comes only from the hole, arcs outward and down, and gets weaker as the level in the bucket falls; it does not squirt upward.

caption: A tray of dry rice is tilted to one side, and the rice slides to the low edge and piles up there while the high side clears.
expectation: The grains flow downhill as a sheet once the tilt is steep enough, collect against the low rim, and the pile's surface settles at a slope; they do not move uphill or stay spread evenly on a tilted tray.

caption: A sandbag on a low wall is punctured near its bottom, and a thin stream of sand runs out onto the ground while the bag slowly slumps.
expectation: The stream comes only from the hole and falls straight down, building a small cone below; the bag sags and wrinkles as it empties; the sand does not flow back in or stop while the bag is still full.

caption: A sack of potatoes is tipped out onto a barn floor, and the potatoes tumble out and roll apart into a loose spread.
expectation: The potatoes fall and roll away from the pile, coming to rest scattered; they do not stack or stay in the sack's shape.

caption: A model rocket reaches the top of its flight, its nose pops off and a parachute unfolds, and the rocket drifts slowly down under the canopy.
expectation: The canopy fills and rounds out above the rocket, whose fall slows sharply the moment it opens; the rocket hangs below the canopy and drifts with the wind; it does not keep falling fast or rise.

caption: The sail of a small boat is let loose in a breeze, and it fills and bellies out to one side.
expectation: The sail bulges away from the wind and flaps when the wind drops; it does not belly toward the wind.

caption: A gust of wind reaches a row of wind turbines on a hill, and the blades start turning and speed up.
expectation: The blades begin turning only when the wind arrives and slow when it drops; all turbines turn the same way.

caption: A gymnast performs a cartwheel across a mat, hands then feet touching the ground in turn.
expectation: Her hands and feet touch the mat one after another in sequence, her body stays whole and bends only at the joints, and she lands upright.

caption: A person walking along a pavement catches a foot on a raised kerb, stumbles forward with arms flung out, and recovers balance after two quick steps.
expectation: The stumble begins at the trip, the body pitches forward and the arms come up; the recovery steps are quick and in the direction of travel; the person does not fall backward or freeze mid-fall.

caption: A person carries a full bucket of water in one hand and leans the body to the other side to balance the load.
expectation: The lean is away from the bucket and appears as soon as the bucket is lifted; the free arm may swing out; the person does not lean toward the bucket or walk upright as if it weighed nothing.

caption: A person standing on one leg wobbles, sways further, and puts the other foot down to stay upright.
expectation: The sway grows before the foot comes down and stops after it lands; the foot lands on the side the body was leaning toward; the person does not stay perfectly still or fall over.

caption: A silk scarf draped over the back of a chair slides off and pools in soft folds on the floor.
expectation: The scarf slips down following the chair's shape, falls as a limp sheet, and lands in loose folds; it does not stay rigid, float, or land flat as a square.

caption: A sock is pulled over a foot, the opening stretching as the fabric is drawn up over the heel and ankle.
expectation: The sock stretches around the foot and follows its shape; the foot goes into the opening, not through the fabric.

caption: A wet paper towel is laid over the top of an upright bottle, and it drapes and clings to the bottle's shape.
expectation: The towel folds down over the bottle's shoulders and hangs along its sides, showing the shape beneath; it does not stay flat like a lid or slide off.

caption: A coil of rope is thrown onto a dock, and it lands in a loose tangle of loops.
expectation: The rope bends into loops that lie on top of one another; it does not pass through itself or land in a straight line.

caption: A coin is pushed under the edge of a rug, and when the rug is lifted the coin lies where it was pushed.
expectation: A small bump shows in the rug where the coin is; the coin is hidden while covered and is the same coin, in that spot, when the rug is lifted.

caption: A bus drives behind a tall building and emerges from the other side a moment later.
expectation: The bus is hidden for a time matching its speed and the building's width, and reappears at the same speed and heading; it does not show through the building.

caption: A marble is dropped into the top of a long cardboard tube standing upright, and it comes out of the bottom and rolls away.
expectation: The marble is hidden inside the tube and exits at the bottom after a short delay; the same marble comes out, and nothing exits before it enters.

caption: A cat crawls under a blanket on a bed, and a moving lump travels across the blanket to the far edge, where the cat comes out.
expectation: The lump is the cat's size and moves continuously; the cat is not visible through the blanket and emerges only at the edge.

caption: A train pulls out of a station, and a suitcase standing loose in the aisle tips over toward the rear of the carriage.
expectation: The suitcase begins to tip as the train starts moving, falls toward the back of the carriage, and lies still once down; it does not tip before the train moves or fall toward the front.

caption: A tablecloth is pulled sharply out from under a set of plates and glasses, and the dishes stay almost where they were on the bare table.
expectation: The cloth leaves the table in one quick motion while the dishes shift only slightly and settle; they do not fly off with the cloth, rise, or move before the cloth is pulled.

caption: A ripe apple comes loose from a branch and drops through the leaves to the grass beneath the tree.
expectation: The apple falls straight down, speeding up as it goes, brushes through leaves without stopping, and comes to rest on the grass below the branch; it does not drift sideways, pause, or rise.

caption: A drone hovering over a field loses power, and it drops straight down into the grass.
expectation: The drone starts falling the moment its rotors stop, accelerates downward, and lands below where it hovered; it does not glide away, slow before landing, or stay in the air with the rotors still.

caption: A wrecking ball swings into a brick wall, and bricks burst out of the far side as the ball is stopped and swings back.
expectation: The bricks move only at the moment of impact and fly away from the ball; the ball loses most of its speed at the wall and swings back less far than it came; the ball does not pass through the wall or stop before touching it.

caption: A car brakes hard on a dry road, its tyres screech and leave dark skid marks, and it stops within a short distance.
expectation: The marks appear behind the tyres only while the car is braking and stay on the road after it stops; the car slows quickly and comes to rest, not sliding on as it would on ice.

caption: A wooden crate rests on a board that is slowly tilted up at one end; the crate stays put as the slope grows, then suddenly slides down to the bottom.
expectation: The crate does not move at shallow angles, starts sliding all at once when the slope is steep, and speeds up on the way down; it does not creep at every angle or slide uphill.

caption: A pumpkin is launched from a catapult on a field, arcs high over the grass, and smashes on the ground far away.
expectation: The pumpkin rises, slows near the top of its arc, and falls faster toward the ground; it breaks apart only when it lands and does not hover, change direction in the air, or bounce whole.

caption: A ping-pong ball is served, arcs over the net, bounces once on the far side of the table, and drops off the end.
expectation: The ball follows a smooth arc, bounces lower than its flight height, and falls off the table edge under gravity; it does not pass through the net, hover, or bounce higher than it came.

caption: A broom is stood upright on the end of its handle in the middle of a kitchen floor and let go; it stays for a moment, leans more and more, and falls to the floor.
expectation: The lean grows steadily faster once it starts and the broom falls in the direction it leaned; it does not stand indefinitely, right itself, or fall before it begins to lean.

caption: A round-bottomed roly-poly toy on a table is pushed over onto its side and let go, and it rocks back upright and settles.
expectation: The toy swings back toward upright as soon as it is released, rocks a few times with shrinking swings, and ends up standing; it does not stay on its side or tip over the other way.

caption: A backpack is hooked to a bungee cord hanging from a beam and let go; the cord stretches, the pack bounces back up, and it bobs up and down before settling.
expectation: The cord lengthens as the pack drops and shortens as it rises, each bounce smaller than the last; the pack never rises above the point where it was released and the cord does not go slack while the pack hangs.

caption: A wet blanket is thrown over a thin washing line, the line sags deeply, then snaps, and the blanket falls to the grass.
expectation: The sag deepens under the weight before the break; at the snap the two ends of the line spring apart and the blanket drops straight down; the line does not hold the load after breaking or rejoin.

caption: A brick is set on top of a coil spring standing on a table, the spring compresses under it, and when the brick is lifted off the spring extends again.
expectation: The spring shortens only while the brick is on it and returns to its full height after the brick is removed; it does not stay compressed or stretch longer than it started.

caption: A car reverses slowly into a lamp post, and its rear bumper dents inward and stays dented after it pulls forward.
expectation: The dent forms at the point of contact at the moment of impact and remains when the car moves away; the bumper does not spring back to shape and the post does not bend.

caption: A lawnmower runs across an overgrown lawn, and the grass behind it is cut short with clippings scattered.
expectation: The grass is shorter only where the mower has passed, the cut edge follows the mower's path, and clippings appear behind it; the grass ahead stays tall and does not grow back behind.

caption: A dog bites into a stuffed cushion on a sofa and tears it open, and white stuffing spills out through the rip.
expectation: The fabric parts where the teeth pull, the rip widens as the dog tugs, and stuffing comes out only through the rip; the cushion does not seal itself or shrink back to shape.

caption: An empty glass bottle is pushed neck-first under the water in a sink, and water flows in while a stream of bubbles escapes from the neck.
expectation: Water rises inside the bottle while air leaves as bubbles that climb to the surface; the bottle fills only as fast as the air escapes and does not fill instantly or stay empty under water.

caption: A snow plough drives down a street, and the snow rolls up along its blade and is left in a ridge at the roadside.
expectation: Snow piles against the blade and spills off its end as the plough moves, leaving a continuous ridge behind and a cleared strip in its path; snow does not pass through the blade or return to the cleared strip.

caption: The base of a steep pile of dry sand in a sandbox is scraped away, and a section of the slope above slides down as a sheet and comes to rest at a gentler angle.
expectation: The slide starts where the support was removed and moves downhill, grains flowing rather than tumbling as a block; the pile ends flatter than it began and does not steepen or rebuild itself.

caption: A car speeds past a pile of dry leaves at the roadside, and the leaves are whirled up in its wake and settle again behind it.
expectation: The leaves lift only as the car passes, swirl in the direction of travel, and drift back down after it has gone; they do not move before the car arrives or rise indefinitely.

caption: A gust through an open window blows the bedroom door shut with a bang.
expectation: The door swings closed in the direction the curtains blow and stops at the frame; it does not close in still air or swing against the wind.

caption: A person jumps down from a low garden wall, lands on both feet and bends deeply at the knees, then straightens up and walks on.
expectation: The knees bend on landing and the body sinks before rising again; the landing is heavier than the take-off; the person does not land stiff-legged, float down, or bounce back up onto the wall.

caption: A curtain is drawn along its rail to one side, and the fabric gathers into deep folds as it bunches at the end.
expectation: The folds grow deeper and closer together as more curtain arrives, the hem stays hanging under gravity, and the cloth does not stiffen, stretch, or pass through itself.

caption: A red sock is tossed into a front-loading washing machine with other clothes and the door shut; through the glass window the sock is seen tumbling past among the clothes.
expectation: The sock appears at the window now and then as the drum turns, always the same sock, and never outside the machine while the door is shut; it does not vanish for good or multiply.

caption: A slice of cheese is laid on a hot dog straight off the grill, and the cheese softens and slumps over the sides.
expectation: The slice loses its stiff edges and drapes down over the sausage; it does not stay square or re-harden on the hot surface.

caption: A handful of gummy bears is scattered on a hot baking tray, and they soften, slump and spread into flat glossy blobs.
expectation: Each bear loses its shape from the bottom up, going shiny and flattening into a wider, lower blob; the blobs do not keep sharp features, shrink upward, or firm up again on the hot tray.

caption: Snow scraped off a windshield lands on the warm bonnet of a car whose engine has just been running, and it melts into rivulets that run off the edge.
expectation: The snow darkens and slumps where it touches the metal, water runs downhill off the bonnet and drips from the edge; the snow does not stay white and dry on the warm metal or refreeze there.

caption: A snowball thrown against a warm sunlit window sticks for a moment, then slides down the glass as it melts, leaving a wet streak.
expectation: The snow softens, slides downward, and leaves water behind; it does not climb or refreeze on the warm glass.

caption: Morning sun falls on half of a frosted car windshield, and the frost on the sunlit half turns to droplets while the shaded half stays white.
expectation: The clearing spreads only within the sunlit area, frost turning wet and then clear with drops running down; the shaded half stays frosted; frost does not re-form on the sunlit glass.

caption: Chocolate sprinkles are scattered over hot buttered toast, and they soften and smear into dark streaks.
expectation: The sprinkles lose their hard edges and go glossy where they touch the hot toast, merging into streaks; they do not stay as separate hard grains or harden again while the toast is hot.

caption: A pot of boiling water is flung into the air on a day far below freezing, and the spray turns into a cloud of ice crystals and vapour that drifts away instead of falling as water.
expectation: The arc of water breaks into a white cloud almost at once and the cloud hangs and drifts with the air; little or no liquid water reaches the ground; the cloud does not gather back into a stream.

caption: A garden sprayer mists water onto a bare branch in deep winter cold, and the mist freezes into a white glaze on the twigs within seconds.
expectation: The wet twigs turn white and glassy shortly after the mist lands and the glaze thickens with more spraying; drops that formed stop running and hang as ice; the glaze does not melt off while the cold holds.

caption: A scoop of sorbet is set on a waffle fresh off the iron, and it slumps and runs into the squares.
expectation: The scoop softens from the bottom, sinks and spreads, and coloured liquid fills the waffle's grid and runs off the edge; the scoop does not stay a firm ball or refreeze on the hot waffle.

caption: A chocolate bunny stands on a plate under a bright heat lamp, and its ears soften, droop and bend over.
expectation: The parts nearest the lamp go glossy and sag first, bending downward under their own weight; the bunny does not stand back up or firm up while the lamp is on.

caption: Vegetables are tossed in a wok over a high flame, and a cloud of steam rises with each toss.
expectation: Steam rises from the hot food and thins above the wok; each toss releases a fresh burst; it does not sink.

caption: A toy steam engine's boiler is heated by a small burner, and once the water boils, steam puffs from the cylinder and the flywheel begins to turn.
expectation: Nothing moves until steam appears; the flywheel starts turning as the puffs begin and speeds up as the steam grows; it does not turn before the boiler is hot or keep turning after the steam stops.

caption: A hot bath is being run, and steam rises from the falling water and fills the bathroom.
expectation: The steam rises from the tap stream and the bath surface and collects near the ceiling; the mirror may fog.

caption: A frying pan straight off a high flame is put under a running tap, and the water hisses into a burst of steam and spits.
expectation: The steam erupts the instant the water meets the pan and rises, fading as the pan cools and the hissing dies down; the water does not sit quietly in the hot pan.

caption: The bleed valve on an old radiator is opened, and a hiss of steam escapes until water spurts out and the valve is shut.
expectation: The steam jet rises from the valve while it is open and stops when the water arrives and the valve is closed.

caption: A saucer that has been covering a steaming mug of tea is lifted off, and a puff of steam escapes while the saucer's underside is beaded with drops.
expectation: The puff rises the moment the cover lifts and thins; the drops on the underside run to the lowest point and fall or hang there; the saucer's underside is not dry and the steam does not appear before the saucer moves.

caption: A pot of jam boils on a stove, and the surface foams up and bubbles thickly.
expectation: The foam rises while the heat is on and sinks back when the pot is pulled off; the bubbles burst slowly on the thick surface.

caption: A pot of potatoes boils with its lid on, and the lid rattles and lifts as steam escapes around its edge.
expectation: The lid jumps in time with the puffs of steam and steam rises from the gap; the rattling stops when the heat is turned down.

caption: A moka pot on a stove starts to gurgle, and coffee sputters up into the top chamber with puffs of steam.
expectation: The coffee appears in the upper chamber only after the gurgling starts and rises in spurts, steam puffing from the spout; the flow does not run back down or begin before the pot is hot.

caption: A hot towel is unrolled on a counter, and steam rises from the cloth as it opens.
expectation: Steam rises from the whole unfolded towel, thickest as it is first opened, and fades as the towel cools.

caption: A bottle from the fridge and an identical bottle from a cupboard stand side by side on a warm counter, and only the cold one beads with water.
expectation: Mist and then drops form on the cold bottle and run down, wetting the counter beneath it; the room-temperature bottle stays dry throughout; the cold one does not dry off while it is still cold.

caption: A snorkelling mask worn in warm water fogs on the inside with each breath.
expectation: The fog forms on the inner surface and thickens with each exhale; the outside of the glass stays clear.

caption: The inside of a tent wall is covered in dew at dawn; the wall is tapped and drops rain down inside the tent.
expectation: Before the tap the drops cling in place; at the tap they run together and fall straight down onto the groundsheet; the wall is drier where they fell from and the drops do not return.

caption: A chilled cocktail glass is set on a bar in a warm room, and a film of mist forms on it and turns into running drops.
expectation: The mist appears evenly on the cold glass and beads run down to wet the bar mat; the glass does not dry while cold.

caption: A metal water bottle packed with ice sits on a gym bench, and a wet patch spreads on the bench beneath it.
expectation: Droplets form on the cold metal and run down to the base, and the patch grows while the bottle stays cold.

caption: Rain begins on a warm, humid day while a car sits with its windows shut, and the inside of the windshield fogs over while the wipers sweep the outside without clearing it.
expectation: The fog forms on the inner face and thickens; each wiper pass clears rain from the outside but leaves the haze unchanged; the fog does not vanish with the wipers.

caption: A fridge door is opened in a steamy kitchen, and the cold glass shelves inside fog over.
expectation: The haze appears on the cold shelves and inner walls within moments of the door opening and thickens while it stays open; it does not appear on the warm outside of the door and does not form before the door opens.

caption: A warm loaf fresh from the oven is slid into a clear plastic bag, and the inside of the bag fogs over.
expectation: The fog forms on the inner face of the bag within moments, thickest above the loaf, and gathers into drops; the outside of the bag stays dry and the fog does not appear before the loaf is inside.

caption: A cup of hot coffee stands on the dashboard of a cold car, and a patch of fog spreads on the windshield above it.
expectation: The patch appears directly above the cup and grows outward while the coffee steams; the rest of the glass stays clear; the patch does not form below the cup or on the outside of the glass.

caption: A horse snorts in a cold stable, and clouds of breath puff from its nostrils and fade.
expectation: A cloud appears at each snort just in front of the nostrils, spreads and vanishes within a second or two; nothing is visible between breaths; the clouds do not sink to the floor.

caption: The door of a wood stove is opened, and the flames inside lean out toward the opening and flare up.
expectation: The flames grow and lean as the door opens and settle back when it shuts; they always point upward from the logs.

caption: A birthday cake with lit candles is carried across a room, and the flames lean backward as it moves and stand up when it is set down.
expectation: The flames trail opposite to the direction of motion, flicker, and return to pointing upward when the cake stops; none goes out unless blown.

caption: A line of flame advances across a stubble field with the wind, smoke drifting ahead of it.
expectation: The fire line moves downwind, blackened ground is left behind it, and the smoke leans the same way as the flames.

caption: A small blowtorch is played over charcoal in a barbecue, and the coals begin to glow where the flame touches them.
expectation: The glow appears only where the torch is aimed and spreads slowly to neighbouring coals; the flame points where the torch points.

caption: A dry pine cone is tossed into a fireplace, and it catches, glows, and crumbles into embers.
expectation: The cone lights where it touches the flames, burns from that side, and shrinks into glowing pieces that fade; it does not return whole.

caption: A candle burns inside a glass lantern hung outdoors, and its flame flickers as gusts pass but stays lit.
expectation: The flame leans and dances with each gust and stands upright between gusts; the glass protects it from going out.

caption: A floating candle in a bowl of water burns down until the flame reaches the water and goes out with a hiss.
expectation: The flame shrinks as the wax runs out, dies the moment the water reaches the wick, and a wisp of smoke rises; the flame does not burn on at the waterline or relight.

caption: A pan of rice left on the stove boils dry, and smoke begins to rise as the grains on the bottom scorch black.
expectation: Steam gives way to thin smoke as the last water goes, the smoke thickens and rises from the pan, and the blackening spreads from the bottom; the rice does not turn white again.

caption: A stick of incense burns in a holder, and the grey ash column lengthens, curls, and finally drops into the tray.
expectation: The glowing tip creeps down the stick as the ash above it grows and bends; the ash falls under gravity when it breaks and lands in the tray; the stick does not get longer and the ash does not reattach.

caption: A burning sheet of newspaper is held up inside a fireplace opening, and its flames are pulled upward into the chimney.
expectation: The flames and smoke bend up toward the flue rather than out into the room, and the paper is consumed from the burning edge inward; the flames do not lean out into the room or point downward.

caption: A sugar cube is dropped into a glass of hot water and another into a glass of cold water at the same moment, and the cube in hot water crumbles and vanishes first.
expectation: Both cubes sink; the one in hot water darkens, slumps and disappears while the one in cold water is still a visible lump; the cold cube does not dissolve faster than the hot one.

caption: A hot-air popcorn machine is switched on, and popped kernels burst out of the chute into a bowl.
expectation: Kernels pop into much larger pieces and are blown out only after the machine has heated; the flow stops when it is switched off.

caption: Two jars of honey are tipped side by side, one straight from the fridge and one that sat in the sun; the warm honey pours out in a quick stream while the cold honey barely moves.
expectation: The warm honey flows out and down at once in a thinner stream; the cold honey creeps or stays put in the same time; neither flows upward and the cold jar does not empty faster.

caption: Candles are lit beneath a wooden Christmas pyramid, and its fan blades start turning and the figures rotate.
expectation: The blades turn only after the candles are lit and slow to a stop when they are blown out.

caption: A raw red steak is laid in a hot pan, and its surface turns from red to grey-brown from the edges inward while it sizzles.
expectation: The colour change starts at the edges and where the meat touches the pan and spreads inward; it never reverses; the steak shrinks slightly and does not stay red on the hot surface.

caption: A whole green pepper rests on a wire rack over a gas flame, and its skin blisters, puffs up and blackens where the flame touches it.
expectation: Blisters rise and the skin darkens only on the side facing the flame, the black patches spreading and never fading; the skin does not smooth out again or blacken on the side away from the flame.

caption: A papadum is dropped into hot oil, and it puffs up and doubles in size within seconds.
expectation: The flat disc blisters and expands as soon as it hits the oil and keeps its puffed shape when lifted out; it does not shrink back.

caption: A pan straight from the stove is set down on a thin plastic cutting board, and the board warps and its edges lift.
expectation: The board bends under and around the hot pan and keeps some of the warp after the pan is removed; it does not stay perfectly flat.

caption: A sealed, half-crushed plastic water bottle is dropped into a bowl of hot water, and its crushed sides push back out until the bottle is round.
expectation: The dents move outward within seconds of the bottle entering the hot water and the bottle ends up round and taut; the sides do not cave in further or change before the bottle is in the water.

caption: Slices of cheese on toast sit under a hot grill, and the cheese bubbles and browns in dark spots.
expectation: The cheese first goes glossy and soft, then bubbles rise and burst on its surface and brown patches appear and darken; the browning never lightens and the cheese does not firm back up under the grill.

caption: A rowing boat drifts across a clear shallow bay in sunshine, and its shadow slides along the sandy bottom beneath it.
expectation: The shadow lies on the sea floor on the side away from the sun, keeps the boat's outline, and moves with the boat; it does not lag behind, float on the surface, or point toward the sun.

caption: Steam rises from a kettle spout in a sunlit kitchen, and a faint, shifting shadow of the plume drifts on the wall behind it.
expectation: The shadow is on the side of the plume away from the window, moves and thins as the steam does, and is fainter than the kettle's own shadow; it does not appear on the sunlit side or stay still while the steam moves.

caption: A sunlit glass door swings open, and the shadow of its frame sweeps across the floor as it turns.
expectation: The frame's shadow turns with the door and stays attached to the hinge side; the glass panes cast little shadow while the frame casts a dark one; the shadow does not move before the door does.

caption: An upside-down bicycle's front wheel is spun in front of a wall lit by a lamp, and the shadows of its spokes whirl across the wall.
expectation: The spoke shadows turn in step with the wheel and slow as it slows; the rim's shadow stays put while the spokes' shadows move; the shadows fall on the side of the wheel away from the lamp.

caption: A parked bicycle casts a sharp shadow on a sunny wall, and a passing cloud makes the shadow fade and then return.
expectation: The shadow softens and vanishes as the cloud covers the sun and comes back in the same place when the sun returns; the bike does not move.

caption: A vase on a table is lit by two lamps from different sides and casts two shadows; one lamp is switched off, and the shadow on the far side of that lamp vanishes while the other stays.
expectation: Each shadow lies away from its own lamp; when one lamp goes off, only the shadow opposite it disappears and the remaining shadow does not move or darken; the vase itself stays lit by the other lamp.

caption: A garden parasol is tilted in bright sun, and its round shadow slides across the patio.
expectation: The shadow moves in the direction opposite to the tilt of the canopy and stays on the side away from the sun; it keeps roughly its round shape and does not detach from the pole's base.

caption: A cat sits on a sunny fence, jumps down, and its shadow leaves the fence and lands with it on the ground.
expectation: The shadow stays on the surfaces below the cat, separates during the jump, and rejoins at the paws on landing.

caption: A spotlight is swung across a statue on a plinth, and the statue's shadow on the backdrop swings the opposite way.
expectation: The shadow moves in the direction opposite to the light's movement and always falls away from the spotlight; it stretches when the light is low and shrinks when the light is overhead.

caption: A hot-air balloon drifts low over a field in the morning sun, and its huge shadow glides across the crops below.
expectation: The shadow moves with the balloon, lies on the side away from the low sun, and is stretched by the low light; it does not fall directly beneath the balloon or stay behind.

caption: A bird lands on the edge of a car's side mirror, and its reflection appears in the glass and moves in step with it.
expectation: The reflection appears the moment the bird is in front of the mirror, moves at the same instant as the bird, and is mirrored; it does not lag or stay after the bird flies off.

caption: A dog trots along a jetty over a still lake, and its upside-down reflection trots beneath it in the water.
expectation: The reflection is inverted, joined to the jetty's reflection at the waterline, and moves with the dog; it blurs only where a ripple passes.

caption: A dog barks at its own reflection in a shop window, and the reflected dog barks back, faint over the goods on display behind the glass.
expectation: The reflected dog moves at the same instant and is mirrored; it is fainter than the real dog and overlaps the display behind the glass; it does not move on its own.

caption: A phone lying on a coffee table lights up, and its glowing reflection appears in the dark television screen facing it.
expectation: The reflection appears at the instant the phone lights and disappears when it goes dark; it is mirrored and dimmer than the phone; nothing appears in the screen before the phone lights.

caption: A bird flies over a puddle, and its reflection crosses the puddle upside down and leaves at the puddle's edge.
expectation: The reflected bird appears only within the puddle, inverted, and moves in step with the real bird; it does not continue onto the dry pavement.

caption: A mirrored wardrobe door swings shut, and the reflected room sweeps across the mirror until it shows only the wall.
expectation: The scene in the mirror slides smoothly as the door turns and changes to whatever the mirror faces; it does not stay fixed on one view.

caption: A shopping trolley rolls along an aisle under a convex security mirror, and its small curved reflection slides across the mirror.
expectation: The reflection is much smaller than the trolley and bulges with the mirror's curve; it moves the same way as the trolley and leaves the mirror when the trolley leaves its view.

caption: A dog drinks from a still pond, and its reflection breaks into ripples where its tongue touches the water.
expectation: The reflection is inverted and sharp until the tongue touches; it fragments where ripples spread and settles when the dog stops.

caption: A car drives past a puddle at night, and the reflections of its headlights slide across the puddle's surface.
expectation: The reflected lights move with the car and appear only within the puddle's edges; they vanish when the car has passed.

caption: A car with a glossy black bonnet drives under a bridge, and the sky reflected in the bonnet is replaced by the dark underside of the bridge and then by sky again.
expectation: The reflection changes exactly as the car passes beneath the bridge and back into the open; it shows what is above the car, not what is ahead; the bonnet does not keep reflecting sky under the bridge.

caption: A straw stands in a glass holding a layer of oil floating on water, and it looks bent twice, once at the oil's surface and again at the boundary between oil and water.
expectation: Both kinks sit exactly at the two liquid surfaces and vanish when the straw is lifted out; the straw itself is straight and the part above the liquid is unchanged.

caption: Rain drips from a twig, and each hanging drop shows a tiny upside-down image of the garden behind it that vanishes when the drop falls.
expectation: The image is inverted and confined to the drop; it swells with the drop and disappears the instant the drop falls; the garden itself is unchanged.

caption: A menu is slid under the clear glass top of a café table, and it stays legible through the glass.
expectation: The menu is seen sharply through the glass with only a faint reflection over it; the glass neither hides nor distorts it.

caption: A goldfish swims around a round bowl, and seen through the curved glass it appears to swell and shrink as it passes the curve.
expectation: The size change happens only through the curved glass and water; the fish keeps its true size and shape.

caption: A coin lies at the bottom of an empty clear jug; as water is poured in, the coin appears to lift toward the surface and look larger.
expectation: The apparent rise and enlargement grow as the water deepens and disappear if the water is poured out; the coin itself does not move from the bottom.

caption: A cat sits behind a glass patio door watching a bird on the lawn, paws at the glass, and cannot reach the bird.
expectation: The bird is visible through the glass and the paw stops at the pane; the cat does not pass through and the bird is not hidden.

caption: A ball rolls past a wall of glass bricks, and seen through the bricks it appears as a broken row of warped pieces that move together.
expectation: The distorted pieces move in step with the ball and only within the bricks; the ball looks whole and normal where it passes the open edge of the wall.

caption: Street lights are seen through a glass of fizzy water, and they wobble and sparkle as bubbles rise through the glass.
expectation: The distortion changes with the rising bubbles and the lights are steady when seen past the glass; the lights themselves do not move.

caption: A candle burns behind a full round wine glass, and seen through the glass the flame appears tiny and upside down.
expectation: The inverted small flame appears only through the liquid-filled part of the glass and flickers in step with the real flame; the flame seen past the glass is upright and normal.

caption: A laser pointer's beam enters a tank of slightly milky water at an angle, and the beam bends where it crosses the surface.
expectation: The beam is straight in the air and straight in the water but kinks at the surface, bending toward the vertical; the kink moves with the entry point and there is no bend when the beam is aimed straight down.

caption: A lit lantern is lowered into a well on a rope, and the circle of lit stone around it slides down the shaft.
expectation: The brightest ring of wall is level with the lantern and moves down with it; the wall above darkens as the lantern passes; the light does not stay at the top or light the whole shaft evenly.

caption: A cat trots along a night street beneath a row of streetlamps, brightening as it passes under each lamp and fading in the dark stretches between.
expectation: The cat is brightest directly under each lamp and dimmest midway between lamps, repeating for each lamp; its shadow points away from the nearest lamp and swaps sides as it passes beneath.

caption: A lantern is lit in a dark barn, and the nearby hay and beams brighten while the far end stays in shadow.
expectation: Brightness is greatest near the lantern and falls off with distance; shadows fall away from it.

caption: The flap of a lit tent is unzipped from inside at night, and lantern light spills out onto the grass in a triangle that widens as the flap opens.
expectation: The lit patch appears only once the flap parts and grows with the opening; it lies in front of the doorway and fades with distance; the grass beside the tent stays dark.

caption: A car with its headlights on turns a corner at night, and the beams sweep across a row of parked cars.
expectation: Each parked car brightens as the beams cross it and darkens after; the lit area moves with the turning car.

caption: A flashlight is pressed against the back of a large leaf in a dark room, and the leaf glows green with its veins showing dark.
expectation: The glow is brightest where the lens touches and fades toward the leaf's edges; the veins are darker than the blade; the glow disappears when the flashlight is switched off.

caption: A moth flutters through the beam of a projector in a dark hall and is brightly lit only while it is inside the cone of light.
expectation: The moth is dim outside the beam, flares bright as it enters, and dims again as it leaves; its shadow appears on the screen while it is in the beam.

caption: A candle is carried behind a paper screen in a dark room, and a soft glow travels across the screen with it.
expectation: The glow is brightest opposite the flame and fades outward; it moves with the candle and flickers with it; the screen is dark where the candle is not.

caption: A train runs through a tunnel with its headlight on, lighting the walls ahead of it while the walls behind fall back into darkness.
expectation: The lit stretch stays ahead of the train and moves with it; the wall brightens as the beam reaches it and darkens once the train has passed; the far end of the tunnel is not lit until the beam reaches it.

caption: The sun comes out from behind a cloud over a beach, and the sand and sea brighten all at once.
expectation: The whole scene brightens together and sharp shadows appear; it dims again when the next cloud passes.

caption: A lump of red play-dough is kneaded together with a lump of blue, and the mixture turns purple.
expectation: Purple appears where the two colours fold together and spreads until no streaks remain; the colours do not separate again.

caption: A squirt of yellow mustard and a squirt of red ketchup are stirred together on a plate, and the mixture turns orange.
expectation: Orange appears where the two sauces meet and spreads with stirring until the streaks are gone; the mixture does not turn back to separate red and yellow.

caption: A green spotlight is aimed at a white marble statue in a garden at night, and the statue appears green.
expectation: The statue takes the light's colour only where the beam falls and returns to white when the light is switched off.

caption: A pigeon walks past outside a window fitted with coloured glass panes and appears red, then blue, then yellow as it passes behind each pane.
expectation: The pigeon takes the colour of whichever pane it is behind and changes at each pane's edge; it looks its normal grey through the clear frame between panes; the panes themselves do not change colour.

caption: A rainbow appears in the mist at the foot of a waterfall on a sunny day, and fades when a cloud covers the sun.
expectation: The rainbow sits within the mist opposite the sun, keeps its arc while the sun shines, and disappears when the sun is hidden.

caption: A white ball on a white table is lit by a red lamp from the left and a blue lamp from the right, and it casts a blue-tinted shadow on one side and a red-tinted shadow on the other.
expectation: The shadow cast by blocking the red lamp is lit only by the blue lamp and looks blue, and vice versa; the ball itself looks magenta-white where both lights fall; switching off one lamp removes its shadow's colour.

caption: A white delivery van drives along a street from beneath orange sodium lamps to beneath white LED lamps, and its paint looks amber and then white.
expectation: The van's colour follows the light falling on it and changes as it passes from one kind of lamp to the next; it does not look white under the orange lamps or amber under the white ones.

caption: A red umbrella is opened in bright sun, and the ground and objects beneath it take on a red tint.
expectation: The red tint appears only in the umbrella's shade and only after it opens; the ground outside the shade keeps its normal colour; the tint disappears when the umbrella closes.

caption: A shiny DVD is tilted in sunlight, and rainbow bands slide across the wall as it turns.
expectation: The coloured bands appear only while the sun hits the disc, move as the disc tilts, and vanish when the disc is turned away or the sun is covered; the wall itself stays white.

caption: A red sock is dropped into a basin of hot soapy water holding white shirts, and the water around it turns pink.
expectation: The pink spreads out from the sock through the water and does not clear again; the shirts nearest the sock take on a faint pink tinge; the sock does not turn white.

caption: A bank of switches in a school gym is flipped one at a time, and the rows of ceiling lights come on one row at a time.
expectation: Each row lights at its own switch and only then; rows whose switch is untouched stay dark.

caption: The key switch on the base of a desk lamp is turned, and the lamp lights.
expectation: The lamp lights exactly at the click and stays lit; it does not light before the key turns or flicker on its own.

caption: A cat walks up the steps of a dark porch, and the motion-sensor light above the door comes on.
expectation: The light comes on as the cat enters the sensor's range and not before; the porch brightens at that instant and stays lit while the cat is there; the light does not come on with nothing moving.

caption: The touch panel of an induction hob is tapped, and the ring's indicator light comes on.
expectation: The indicator lights at the tap and not before; it stays on until the panel is tapped again.

caption: The button on a toy light-sabre is pressed, and the blade lights up from the handle outward to the tip.
expectation: The glow starts at the handle end at the press and runs to the tip in a fraction of a second; the blade is dark before the press and does not light from the tip first.

caption: The switch on a rotating shop display stand is pressed, and the stand begins to turn with its lights on.
expectation: The stand turns and lights only after the switch; it stops and darkens when switched off.

caption: The light switch of a bathroom that also powers the extractor fan is flipped, and the fan blades spin up as the light comes on.
expectation: The fan starts with the light and stops a while after it is switched off; it does not spin with the switch off.

caption: The big red button on a toy fire engine is pressed, and its roof lights flash.
expectation: The flashing starts at the press and stops after a set time or another press; the lights are dark before.

caption: The switch for a porch light is flipped at dusk, and the porch is lit while the garden beyond stays dark.
expectation: The light comes on at the switch, lights the porch, and goes off at the switch; nothing else changes.

caption: A running record player is unplugged, and the turntable slows to a stop while the needle still rests on the record.
expectation: The turntable coasts to a stop within a few seconds of the plug coming out and does not start again; the needle stays down; nothing keeps spinning with the power gone.

caption: Batteries are slid into a toy keyboard whose power switch is already on, and its keys light up.
expectation: The keys light only once the batteries are seated and not before; they stay lit afterwards.

caption: A lamp is plugged into the far end of a long extension cord, and the moment the cord's plug goes into the wall socket at the other side of the room the lamp lights.
expectation: The lamp lights at the instant the far plug goes in, with no delay for the length of the cord; it is dark before and stays lit after.

caption: A cordless drill running on a bench slows and stops as its battery runs flat, and it only twitches when the trigger is pulled again.
expectation: The drill slows gradually and stops; further trigger pulls produce at most a twitch; it does not run again at full speed without charging.

caption: A power cut hits a restaurant, and every light and the neon sign in the window go dark at once while the candles on the tables keep burning.
expectation: All electric lights fail at the same instant; the candle flames are unaffected.

caption: The handle of a wind-up torch is cranked, and the bulb brightens as the handle turns and fades when the cranking stops.
expectation: The bulb is dark before the crank moves, brightens with the turning, and dims within a moment of the handle stopping; it does not stay bright with the handle still.

caption: A remote-control boat slows and stops in the middle of a pond as its battery runs flat.
expectation: The boat loses speed gradually and drifts to a stop; the controller no longer moves it.

caption: A wireless earbud is dropped into its charging case, and a small light on the case begins to blink.
expectation: The light starts only when the earbud is seated in the case and stops when it is taken out.

caption: The safety key is pulled from a running treadmill, and the belt slows and stops.
expectation: The belt coasts to a stop within a second or two of the key coming out and does not move again until the key is back.

caption: Lightning flashes over a vineyard at night, and the rows of vines are lit for an instant before the dark returns.
expectation: The flash is brief and lights everything at once; the vines are dark again immediately.

caption: A lightning bolt strikes a hilltop radio mast, and the mast is outlined in a bright flash.
expectation: The bolt ends at the mast's tip, the flash lasts a fraction of a second, and the mast stands unchanged afterwards.

caption: Lightning flashes over a harbour at night, and the moored boats and their masts are lit for an instant before the dark returns.
expectation: The flash is brief and lights the whole harbour at once; the boats are dark again immediately; their own deck lights stay steady throughout.

caption: Lightning flashes over a snowy village at night, and the snow-covered roofs and street flash white for an instant.
expectation: The whole scene brightens together for a fraction of a second and returns to dark; the house lights stay steady.

caption: A bolt of lightning forks from a cloud to a lone barn in a field, and smoke rises from the barn roof after the flash.
expectation: The bolt is brief and ends at the barn; the smoke appears after and rises; the roof does not glow.

caption: Lightning flickers inside a thunderhead over a desert highway, lighting the cloud from within again and again.
expectation: Each flicker is brief and lights the cloud, not the ground directly; no bolt reaches the road.

caption: Lightning flashes over a city at night, and the flash is mirrored at the same instant in hundreds of windows of a glass tower.
expectation: Every window that faces the flash brightens together and darkens together with it; the reflections last only as long as the flash; the tower's interior lights stay steady.

caption: Lightning flashes over a wet street at night, and the sky and the wet road brighten for an instant while the streetlamps burn steadily throughout.
expectation: The flash lights the road and sky together and is gone in a fraction of a second; the lamps neither brighten nor go out with it; puddles mirror the flash.

caption: A power saw cuts into the roof of a wrecked car, and sparks spray from the blade across the wet road.
expectation: Sparks fly out along the blade's direction, arc down onto the road, and die; they appear only while the blade is cutting.

caption: A skateboard's metal truck grinds along a steel rail at night, and sparks flick off where it scrapes.
expectation: The sparks appear only while the metal is scraping, trail behind the board, and go dark within a fraction of a second; none appear once the board leaves the rail.

caption: A pair of skis slides over an exposed rock, and sparks flash from their metal edges.
expectation: The sparks appear only during the scrape and go dark instantly; none appear on snow.

caption: A lawnmower's blade strikes a hidden stone, and a spark flicks out from under the deck.
expectation: The spark appears at the instant of the strike, flies out low and dies at once; there are no sparks while the mower cuts grass alone.

caption: A pad of steel wool is touched to the terminals of a battery, and sparks race through the wool as its strands glow orange.
expectation: The glow starts at the point of contact and runs along the strands in branching lines; the burnt strands go dark and crumble; nothing glows before the contact.

caption: A model train runs over a stretch of dirty track, and tiny sparks flicker under its wheels.
expectation: The sparks appear only under the moving wheels and only on the dirty stretch; they are brief and do not appear while the train stands still.

caption: A tall blade of grass blows against the wire of an electric fence, and a tiny spark clicks at the contact each time it touches.
expectation: The spark appears exactly when the grass touches the wire and not while it hangs clear; each spark is brief and repeats with each touch; the grass does not catch fire.

caption: A neon sign's box shorts in the rain, and sparks drop from beneath the sign onto the wet pavement.
expectation: The sparks fall downward from the sign box and go dark before or as they land; the sign flickers with each spark.

caption: A magnet is touched to a steel food can and holds; touched to an aluminium drink can beside it, it falls off.
expectation: The magnet stays on the steel can even when let go and drops from the aluminium can at once; the cans do not move on their own.

caption: A toy fishing rod with a magnet on its line is dangled over paper fish fitted with steel clips, and a fish jumps up to the magnet and hangs from it.
expectation: The fish lifts only when the magnet is close, snaps to it by its clip, and hangs from the line as it is raised; fish without clips stay put.

caption: A magnet is slid up the outside of a glass of water, and a steel nut lying at the bottom rises up the inside of the glass behind it.
expectation: The nut moves only where the magnet moves, staying on the inner face opposite the magnet, and stops when the magnet stops; it does not pass through the glass or drift on its own.

caption: Sheets of paper are slid one at a time under a fridge magnet, and after several sheets the magnet loses its grip and slides down the door.
expectation: The magnet holds through the first sheets and slips only once the stack is thick; it slides downward, not up or sideways; it does not hold no matter how thick the stack.

caption: Two toy train cars are pushed together end to end and their magnetic couplers push apart; one car is turned around and the couplers snap together.
expectation: With one orientation the cars separate over the last gap; after turning one car they pull together over that gap and stay joined; nothing happens while the cars are far apart.

caption: A ring magnet is dropped down a pencil standing upright toward another ring magnet at the base with like poles facing, and it stops and floats a little above the lower one.
expectation: The falling ring slows and hovers with a visible gap above the lower ring instead of landing on it; it bobs and settles; it does not fall through the gap or fly off the pencil.

caption: A steel paperclip hangs on a thread, and as a magnet is brought near it the clip swings toward the magnet and hangs at an angle in the air.
expectation: The clip leans toward the magnet only when the magnet is close, tilting more as it approaches, and falls back to vertical when the magnet is taken away; it does not swing away from the magnet.

caption: A magnet swinging on a string over a steel tray dips low on one swing and snaps down onto the tray, stopping dead.
expectation: The magnet swings freely while high, is pulled down sharply only when it comes close to the steel, and stays stuck where it lands; it does not stick to the tray from far away or bounce off.

caption: A plastic cup pulled from a stack clings to the fingers and has to be shaken off.
expectation: The cup stays on her hand when she opens her fingers and drops only after a shake; the other cups in the stack stay put.

caption: A plastic comb rubbed on a wool scarf is held near a thin stream of water from a tap, and the stream bends toward the comb.
expectation: The stream curves toward the comb only while the comb is close and straightens when it is moved away; an unrubbed comb has no effect; the water does not bend away from the comb.

caption: A plastic pipe rubbed on a fleece is held near an empty aluminium can lying on its side, and the can rolls toward the pipe.
expectation: The can starts rolling only when the rubbed pipe is close, follows the pipe as it is moved, and stops when the pipe is taken away; it does not roll away from the pipe.

caption: A small ball of aluminium foil hangs on a thread, and it swings toward a plastic rod that has been rubbed on wool as the rod is brought near.
expectation: The ball leans toward the rod only when the rod is close and hangs straight again when it is removed; it does not move toward an unrubbed rod.

caption: The protective film is peeled off a new television screen, and it clings to the hand holding it and crackles.
expectation: The film sticks to the skin and to itself where it touches and has to be pulled free; it does not drop straight down.

caption: A plastic pen rubbed on a wool sleeve is held over pepper grains scattered on a plate, and the grains jump onto the pen.
expectation: Grains leap only when the rubbed pen is close and cling to it; an unrubbed pen does nothing.

caption: A cat rubs against a wool blanket in a dark room, and tiny sparks crackle in its fur.
expectation: The sparks appear only where the fur moves against the wool and vanish instantly; nothing glows when the cat is still.

caption: Soap bubbles drift past a balloon that has been rubbed on wool, and they curve toward the balloon and cling to it.
expectation: Bubbles change course toward the balloon only when they come near it and stick or pop on its surface; bubbles far from the balloon drift straight on; none curves away from it.

caption: A large temple bell is struck once with its wooden beam, and a small pebble resting on the bell's shoulder skitters and slides off.
expectation: The pebble is still before the strike, jumps and slides at the instant of the blow, and falls off or comes to rest lower down; the bell sways slightly on its hanger; the pebble does not move on its own.

caption: A metal bucket half full of water is struck once with a stick, and the water inside jumps into ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear at the strike, spread and fade within a second or two; the surface is still before and after; the water does not slosh as if the bucket had been tipped.

caption: A wok with a scattering of sesame seeds in it is struck once with a ladle, and the seeds jump.
expectation: The seeds leap at the instant of the blow and settle again; they are still before it; the wok itself does not tip or slide.

caption: A large hanging sheet of thin steel is struck once with a mallet, and waves ripple visibly across the metal as it booms.
expectation: The ripples spread from the point of impact across the sheet and fade over a few seconds; the sheet is flat and still before the strike and does not keep waving after the sound dies.

caption: A struck tuning fork is touched to the corner of a sheet of paper lying on a table, and the paper buzzes and skitters.
expectation: The paper jitters only while the fork touches it and stops when the fork is lifted; an unstruck fork touching it does nothing.

caption: A ping-pong ball rests on the head of a drum; the drum is struck once and the ball bounces high off the head.
expectation: The ball leaves the head at the instant of the strike, rises and falls back, bouncing lower each time; it is still before the strike and does not rise before the stick lands.

caption: A pinch of chalk dust lies on a large cymbal; the cymbal is struck once and the dust flies up in a puff.
expectation: The dust lifts off at the instant of the strike, hangs and drifts down; the cymbal wobbles on its stand; the dust does not move before the blow.

caption: A sheet of paper lies loosely over the grille of a large speaker, and it lifts and flaps with each beat of the bass.
expectation: The paper jumps in time with the beats and lies still between them and when the music stops; it does not move to sound that has no bass.

caption: A garbage truck idles outside a house, and a hanging wind chime by the door trembles and tinkles while the engine runs.
expectation: The trembling lasts while the truck idles and stops after it drives away; the chime is still in quiet air.

caption: A heavy book is dropped flat onto a table, and a pencil lying nearby rolls a little while a glass of water shows a ring of ripples.
expectation: The pencil moves and the ripples appear at the instant of the impact and settle within a second or two; nothing moves before the book lands.

caption: A tuba is played next to a table where a row of dominoes stands on end, and the dominoes shiver on the low notes and one topples.
expectation: The shivering appears with the low notes and stops between them; the topple happens during a note, and once a domino is down it stays down.

caption: A cement mixer rumbles beside a garden wall, and pebbles on the wall's top shiver and shift.
expectation: The pebbles move only while the mixer runs and settle when it stops.

caption: A church organ plays a deep pedal note, and the still water in the stone font nearby breaks into fine ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear when the low note sounds, cover the water surface evenly, and fade within a moment of the note ending; the water is flat before the note and between notes.

caption: A heavy freight train passes a level crossing, and the coins in a cup holder of a waiting car rattle.
expectation: The rattling starts as the train arrives, is strongest as it passes, and stops once it has gone.

caption: A motorcycle idles at a kerb, and its rear-view mirror blurs and the reflection in it shakes until the engine is switched off.
expectation: The blur and shaking last exactly as long as the engine runs and stop within a moment of it being cut; the mirror is sharp before the engine starts.

caption: A large brass singing bowl half full of water is rubbed around its rim with a mallet, and as it sings the water surface breaks into ripples and leaping droplets.
expectation: The ripples and droplets appear only while the rim is being rubbed and die away when the mallet stops; the water is flat before; the bowl does not tip or spill.

caption: A mechanical metronome is set going, and its pendulum swings from side to side with each tick.
expectation: The pendulum swings steadily, reversing at each tick, and slows to a stop only when the metronome is stopped; it does not swing before it is started.

caption: A sewing machine runs at speed, and its needle bar blurs up and down while the table beneath it trembles.
expectation: The blur and trembling last only while the machine runs and stop when it stops; the needle is sharp when still.

caption: A carillon bell in a tower is struck by its hammer, and the hammer swings back while the bell rocks slightly on its mount.
expectation: The hammer moves only to strike and retreat; the bell's rocking begins at the strike and dies away; nothing moves before the hammer falls.

caption: The keys of an old typewriter are struck one after another, and with each clack a type bar flies up to hit the paper and the carriage jumps one step sideways.
expectation: A type bar rises and falls with every keystroke and the carriage moves one notch at the same instant; nothing moves between strokes; the carriage steps in one direction only until it is pushed back.
